newsitem.title: USA: Mac Frugal's sees Q4 gain.
newsitem.headline: Mac Frugal's sees Q4 gain.

text.p: Mac Frugal's Bargains Close-outs Inc Thursday said it it expects to book a net cash injection of approximately $30 million in the fourth quarter and a pretax gain of between $7 million and $9 million, or between $0.16 and $0.20 per share.

The company said the gain is related to a decision not to rebuild the New Orleans Distribution Center that was destroyed by fire in March of this year and to purchase the entire property from the city of New Orleans.

In separate agreements, the company said it had reached a comprehensive settlement with its insurance carriers relating to their obligations contained in their business interruption and building replacement insurance policies. Funds from this settlement will be used to terminate all obligations between the company and TriNet Corporate Realty Trust Inc under the current sublease relating to the New Orleans Distribution Center.
